name: tools-list-before-initialize
proves: tools/list is answered on a connection that never sent initialize, which records that the recorded build does not gate tool discovery behind the initialize lifecycle.

steps.label: tools/list as the very first request

tools.name: health
tools.description: Report adapter status: WebSocket listener state, plugin connection, plugin versions/capabilities, scoped-directory status, and machine-readable setup errors. Read-only; works while Blockbench is closed.

tools.name: get_plugin_status
tools.description: Report plugin/Blockbench versions, capabilities, and scoped-directory status. Read-only.

tools.name: get_project_state
tools.description: Inspect the currently open project: format, name, object counts, and object identifiers. Read-only.

tools.name: get_elements
tools.description: Read back cube and group state: geometry (from/to/origin/rotation), visibility, UV state (box_uv, uv_offset, mirror_uv, per-face uv/rotation/texture reference), and parent/child hierarchy. Cube name/from/to/origin/visibility values are valid update_cube input verbatim; cube rotation reads back as the stored per-axis degree vector. Mesh and locator elements are not returned. Responses share the 16 MiB message limit; pass uuids to bound the response on large projects. Read-only.

uuids.description: Cube/group UUIDs to read back; any unknown UUID fails with E_NOT_FOUND and returns nothing. Omit to return every element.

tools.name: create_cubes
tools.description: Create new cube elements. Always creates new objects and returns their UUIDs.

box_uv.description: Per-cube UV mode (default: the project setting).

uv_offset.description: Box-UV texture offset. Providing UV state disables auto-UV for the cube.

tools.name: update_cube
tools.description: Update one existing cube addressed by UUID. Fails with E_NOT_FOUND for unknown UUIDs.

tools.name: set_cube_uv
tools.description: Set one cube's UV state: box-UV offset/mirroring, per-face UV rectangles with optional quarter-turn rotation, and the UV mode switch (via the cube setUVMode API, honoring the format's optional per-cube box UV). Box fields need box UV mode, faces need per-face mode, mismatches fail with E_INVALID_PARAMS. Explicit UV state disables auto-UV for the cube. One undo step.

box_uv.description: Switch the cube UV mode. A mode differing from the format default needs a format with optional per-cube box UV; otherwise the call fails with E_FORMAT_UNSUPPORTED.

uv_offset.description: Box-UV texture offset; valid in box UV mode only.

mirror_uv.description: Box-UV X mirroring; valid in box UV mode only.

rotation.description: Face texture rotation in degrees (quarter turns).

faces.description: Per-face UV rectangles plus optional rotation; valid in per-face UV mode only.

tools.name: set_texture_resolution
tools.description: Set the project texture resolution (texture_width/texture_height) through the native Blockbench resolution utility, optionally rescaling existing UV coordinates. Resolves the validate_project texture-size mismatch warning. One undo step.

rescale_existing_uv.description: Scale existing UV coordinates to the new resolution. Supported only when Blockbench itself can rescale: the new size is square, the width changes, and old/new widths are integer multiples; otherwise the call fails with E_INVALID_PARAMS before changing anything.

tools.name: delete_cubes
tools.description: Delete existing cubes addressed by UUID.

tools.name: create_group
tools.description: Create a new group/bone. Always creates a new object and returns its UUID.

tools.name: update_group
tools.description: Update one existing group addressed by UUID. Fails with E_NOT_FOUND for unknown UUIDs.

tools.name: delete_group
tools.description: Delete an existing group addressed by UUID; children move to the parent when keep_children is true.

keep_children.description: Move children to the parent instead of deleting them (default false).

tools.name: assign_texture
tools.description: Add a texture from a scoped file path or data URL and apply it to all cubes or to selected cubes/faces. Creates a new texture object.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read a file inside the confirmed scoped directory. Read-only.

tools.name: write_files
tools.description: Write one or more files inside the confirmed scoped directory. Preflights all destinations and writes nothing when any blocker exists; each overwrite must be explicitly flagged per file.

overwrite.description: Required to replace an existing file at this destination; applies to this file only.

tools.name: save_project
tools.description: Save the open project of any format as a .bbmodel file inside the confirmed scoped directory. Compiles through the project codec, whose compile hooks other installed plugins may use to adjust the output. A project without a save path adopts the destination and is marked saved; saving to a path that differs from the current save path leaves the save target and unsaved indicator untouched. Overwrite must be explicitly flagged.

path.description: Destination ending in .bbmodel inside the confirmed scoped directory (absolute or scope-relative).

overwrite.description: Required to replace an existing file at the destination; applies to this write only.

tools.name: capture_screenshot
tools.description: Capture a bounded screenshot of the model preview as a data URL, optionally from a named camera preset rendered offscreen (the visible viewport camera is never modified; "front" depends on the format's forward_direction). Preset renders share the offscreen preview that Blockbench's own screenshot dialog and recorder use; captures are serialized and fail while a recording is running. Read-only.

angle_preset.description: Render from a native Blockbench camera preset through the offscreen preview; the visible viewport camera is never modified. Compass directions are model-space (the model's "front" depends on the format's forward_direction). Omit to capture the currently visible view.

tools.name: validate_project
tools.description: Run Blockbench validation checks and return structured diagnostics. Read-only.

tools.name: propose_scoped_directory
tools.description: Propose a directory for session-scoped AI file access. The Blockbench user must confirm inside Blockbench; rejection returns E_SCOPE_NOT_CONFIRMED.

path.description: Absolute directory path proposed for session-scoped AI file access.

reason.description: Shown to the Blockbench user in the confirmation dialog.

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Create a new Minecraft Java block/item project (Blockbench format java_block) in a new project tab. When an unsaved project is open, force:true is required.

force.description: Required when an unsaved project is open; the new project opens in a separate tab.

tools.name: open_model
tools.description: Open a Java block/item model JSON file from the confirmed scoped directory via the java_block codec, in a new project tab. When an unsaved project is open, force:true is required.

path.description: Model JSON path inside the confirmed scoped directory (absolute or scope-relative).

force.description: Required when an unsaved project is open; the model opens in a separate tab.

tools.name: set_display_transform
tools.description: Set the Java display transform (translation/rotation/scale) for one display slot. Updates in place.

tools.name: export_model
tools.description: Export the current project through the java_block codec to a file inside the confirmed scoped directory. Overwrite must be explicitly flagged.

overwrite.description: Required to replace an existing file at the destination; applies to this write only.

tools.name: create_geckolib_project
tools.description: Create a new GeckoLib animated model project (Blockbench format geckolib_model; requires the third-party GeckoLib plugin) in a new project tab. When an unsaved project is open, force:true is required.

modid.description: Mod namespace (lowercase letters, digits, `_`, `-`, `.`), stored as geckolib_modid.

identifier.description: Object ID used for `geometry.<identifier>` and recommended export file names.

force.description: Required when an unsaved project is open; the new project opens in a separate tab.

tools.name: open_geckolib_model
tools.description: Open a GeckoLib .bbmodel project file from the confirmed scoped directory in a new project tab; rejects .bbmodel files whose format is not geckolib_model. When an unsaved project is open, force:true is required.

path.description: GeckoLib .bbmodel path inside the confirmed scoped directory (absolute or scope-relative).

force.description: Required when an unsaved project is open; the model opens in a separate tab.

tools.name: export_geckolib_model
tools.description: Export the current geckolib_model project geometry as Bedrock-format geo JSON (format_version 1.12.0) to a file inside the confirmed scoped directory; the recommended file name is <identifier>.geo.json. Overwrite must be explicitly flagged.

overwrite.description: Required to replace an existing file at the destination; applies to this write only.

tools.name: export_geckolib_animations
tools.description: Export the current geckolib_model project animations as GeckoLib animation JSON to a file inside the confirmed scoped directory; the recommended file name is <identifier>.animation.json. Fails with E_NOT_FOUND when the project has no animations. Overwrite must be explicitly flagged.

overwrite.description: Required to replace an existing file at the destination; applies to this write only.

tools.name: validate_geckolib_file
tools.description: Validate a Bedrock geometry JSON file and/or a GeckoLib animation JSON file inside the confirmed scoped directory against GeckoLib 4 baseline rules; animation content checks run without geometry, bone cross-checks need both paths. At least one path is required. Returns structured diagnostics. Read-only.

geo_path.description: Bedrock geometry JSON (.geo.json) path inside the confirmed scoped directory.

animation_path.description: GeckoLib animation JSON path inside the confirmed scoped directory; content checks need no geometry, bone cross-checks also need geo_path.

tools.name: upsert_geckolib_animation
tools.description: Create or replace one whole GeckoLib animation clip (keyed by name) on the current geckolib_model project: clip properties plus bone keyframes with easing and molang values, applied atomically in one undo step. Times are seconds; values use the GeckoLib .animation.json convention; molang strings are never evaluated. Overwriting an existing name requires replace:true (fails with E_FILE_EXISTS otherwise); unknown or ambiguous bone names fail with E_INVALID_PARAMS before any project change.

name.description: Animation name (the clip key), e.g. animation.<entity>.<action>.

anim_time_update.description: Molang expression driving clip time (passed through, never evaluated).

time.description: Keyframe time in seconds from clip start.

items.description: A number or a molang expression string (molang is passed through, never evaluated).

value.description: Keyframe value in the GeckoLib .animation.json convention: a number or molang string (applied to all three axes) or an [x, y, z] array of number|molang-string.

interpolation.description: Interpolation to the next keyframe (default linear).

easing.description: GeckoLib per-keyframe easing name (absent means linear).

easingArgs.description: Numeric easing arguments; used by the Back/Elastic/Bounce families and step.

bones.description: Bone name → rotation/position/scale keyframe lists. Bone names must match current group names. Values use the GeckoLib .animation.json convention (what export_geckolib_animations writes): rotation X/Y and position X are stored inverted relative to the Blockbench UI; the handler applies that mapping.

replace.description: Must be true to overwrite an existing animation with the same name; applies to this call only.

tools.name: delete_geckolib_animation
tools.description: Delete one animation clip by name from the current geckolib_model project in one undo step without opening any dialog. Fails with E_NOT_FOUND when no clip has the given name.

tools.name: get_geckolib_animation
tools.description: Read one animation clip by name from the current geckolib_model project, returned in exactly the upsert_geckolib_animation payload shape (keyframes sorted by time, linear interpolation omitted, times in seconds, GeckoLib .animation.json value convention). Read-only.

tools.name: capture_geckolib_animation_frame
tools.description: Capture a bounded screenshot of one named GeckoLib animation posed at a still timestamp. The command temporarily sets only that animation playing for preview, applies GeckoLib loop timing (loop wraps, hold clamps, once rejects out-of-range time), renders through the existing screenshot path, rejects active timeline playback, suppresses effect keyframes during the still preview, and restores animation/timeline state after success or failure. Read-only.

animation.description: Name of the GeckoLib animation clip to pose and capture.

time.description: Timestamp in seconds to render within the named clip.

angle_preset.description: Render the posed GeckoLib model from a native Blockbench camera preset through the offscreen preview; omit to capture the currently visible view.
